fieldData.job-spec:
What is the job? 

But first, Who is Adam? 

Adam is our Chief Strategy Officer, a tremendously fun guy to work with, and an absolute machine for generating brilliant ideas which our tech team has no spare capacity to implement.  After about the hundredth time of sadly replying “that is a really clever notion, but we can’t tackle it right now” we said enough is enough, let’s find someone who can be full-time on taking these ideas to code.

In this role, you will work directly with Adam, straddling Product and Marketing while building a variety of applications and integrations which will provide endless delight to our community.

Are you happiest when working on projects which are completely within your control?  Tired of management ordering you to pound a square-peg technology into a round-hole business requirement?  Does the combination of full authority and full responsibility sound just dandy?  Look no further, your salvation is at hand!

You will be given the autonomy to design and implement the right solutions to a high-level need, with a stupendously capable technical team always at hand to help point you to the data you require.  Language, framework, and any supporting services are all at your discretion - a functional, maintainable end product is the one requirement which rules them all.  We know that it sounds too good to be true, but miracles do happen and we’re in the miracle business.

What are we looking for? 

  • You enjoy working in an ambitious, fast-paced environment that requires conceptual, strategic thinking and a willingness to work solo on projects across multiple channels.
  • You like to develop your own solutions to a set of business requirements, without being required to use a specified technical approach.
  • You have strong attention to detail, and think about “the little things” in the end product without having to be prompted to do so.
  • You’re comfortable with making time estimations and creating intelligent milestones.  You’re used to working under deadlines and communicating your level of confidence in the timeline. 
  • You’re a quick prototyper.  You know how to identify what parts of a solution you’re uncertain about, and it doesn’t take you long to learn enough to prove out an idea.
  • You are happy to take ownership of the products you build, maintaining and iterating on them as necessary.

‍

What do you need?

  • A polyglot enterprise developer who is comfortable with a variety of languages and frameworks.
  • Comfortable with self direction when it comes to high-level tasks.
  • Solid experience with consuming and creating relational databases.
  • Very comfortable with integrating third-party APIs.
  • Lots of experience with building data-driven websites.

‍

Who are we? 

At RDX Works (formally Radix DLT), we're a team of like-minded thinkers who have long been convinced that we're living in the earliest stages of a global financial revolution. This revolution is being fuelled by decentralized finance (or DeFi for short), which is enabling an assortment of pioneering developers and entrepreneurs to re-invent almost every financial product that is currently traded and invested in traditional markets, without requiring central authorities or siloed infrastructure. DeFi has captured a great deal of attention and investment in the crypto-aware niche, growing assets under management from $1 billion to $40 billion in less than a year. Impressive as its growth has been, its current market size isn't even a rounding error on the over $111 trillion held in traditional finance. We're focused on what it will take to go from billions to trillions.

RDX went back to first principles to come up with the right technical solution—the first layer-one protocol built specifically for mainstream DeFi—and we have already tested out at over 1 million transactions per second. We're keenly aware that the need for an infinitely scalable platform is only one prerequisite among many for mass adoption, and we're also blazing new ground in the areas of purpose-built developer tools, user experiences, and regulatory integration.

We have forged a path deep into the future of what distributed ledger technology is going to look like and we need you to come and be part of the team that is making that happen right now.

If this job sounds like it was made for you, then please apply here or email farrah@rdx.works for more information.  

Alternatively, if you feel like you don’t match all of the requirements, we would love you to still apply anyway. We understand that confidence gaps and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting incredible candidates and we wouldn’t want this to prevent us from meeting you; especially as we are big advocates of helping people learn & grow.
